This is the 3rd episode of our Sri Lanka series. Our journey starts with an amazing train journey through Sri Lanka’s beautiful valley of Ella and Nuwara Eliye. It is a 2 day journey. Below are the activities we did in this journey.
We are buying spices from place of origins and making these available for you in smaller quantities.you can check out our website here.
Date of journey - 9th Sept 2026
Ella Railway Station - This station is about 1,040m above sea level. We booked our ticket from Ella to Nanu Oya. Nanu Oya is the nearest railway station to Nuwara Eliya.
